stageB.mathematicalEvidence: Course-specific independent Node oracle and isolated C# verifier; teacher-only graphical/model explanations not machine-graded

proposedFamilies.kind: rational term sequence and common ratio
proposedFamilies.generator: Positive/negative rational initial term and nonzero ratio, explicit index from 0 or 1; n<=20
proposedFamilies.negative: wrong ratio or index; 1/0, NaN, Infinity, out-of-range term
proposedFamilies.rubric: Show growth factor as each new term divided by previous; judge explanation

proposedFamilies.kind: paired exact integer/rational step table and graph
proposedFamilies.generator: n=0..6, pieces 2^n, piece area 80/2^n in square inches
proposedFamilies.verifier: GradeGeometricTerm for count and piece area; verify product=80
proposedFamilies.negative: multiplying each piece area by the wrong step count; negative/noninteger cut
proposedFamilies.rubric: Both graph axes labeled; one series doubles and the other halves; require reasoning about conserved uncut-paper area

proposedFamilies.generator: n=0..5; shaded count=3^n, each shaded area=256/4^n
proposedFamilies.negative: asserting total shaded area constant 256; invalid step, malformed answer
proposedFamilies.rubric: Compare increasing count and decreasing triangle area, explain removed center

proposedFamilies.kind: numeric currency with rounding policy gate
proposedFamilies.generator: month 1=1000 dollars, interest 2% applied monthly with no payments, m in 1..8
proposedFamilies.verifier: GradeUnroundedMonthlyInterestAtDisplay; exact rational before final display rounding
proposedFamilies.negative: start at month 0, add 2 dollars instead of 2%, round differently without explaining policy
proposedFamilies.rubric: Show formula 1000*(1.02)^(m-1); manual adjudication if source permits monthly-rounding alternative; sign-off required
